title: Indonesia's Odekta Naibaho rules first-ever After Dark Tour in Manila

blocks.text: Indonesian star Odekta Naibaho, a three-time Southeast Asian Games gold medalist, emerged as the winner of the first-ever Nike After Dark Tour in Manila, crossing the finish line with a time of 35:19 on Saturday night at the Quirino Grandstand.
